reviews.summary: QNT has a fresh derivatives catalyst: OKX launched QUANT/USDT perpetuals with up to 50× leverage on October 1, 2026. This can materially raise short-term volatility and liquidation-driven whipsaws during a breakout.
materialRisks: New 50× leveraged QNT perpetual market on OKX (live October 1, 2026) creates immediate liquidation/funding-driven volatility risk. ([okx.com](https://www.okx.com/zh-hans/help/okx-to-list-perpetual-futures-for-qnt-crypto?utm_source=openai))

The September 24 Quant/The Clearing House announcement is a recent narrative catalyst, but the network is only expected in H1 2027; execution and token-demand details remain unannounced, increasing event-driven expectation risk. ([theclearinghouse.org](https://www.theclearinghouse.org/payment-systems/Articles/2026/09/The-Clearing-House-Partners-with-Quant-to-Advance-the--On-Chain-Money-Initiative?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: OKX officially listed QUANT/USDT perpetual futures on October 1, 2026, with 0.01×–50× leverage and four-hour funding that can shorten to hourly at funding limits.
The Clearing House selected Quant for its On-Chain Money Initiative on September 24, 2026; participating-institution availability is expected in the first half of 2027.
Binance removed QNT/BTC on August 7 and QNT/USDC on September 18, but stated these were pair removals rather than a full QNT spot-token delisting.
